Cryptography

एपोक की अवधि

The fixed duration or number of blocks defining one epoch cycle in a blockchain network, used for finalizing state, validator rotations, staking rewards distribution, and governance updates.

Definition

The fixed duration or number of blocks defining one epoch cycle in a blockchain network, used for finalizing state, validator rotations, staking rewards distribution, and governance updates.

Operational example

Portfolio staking rewards are calculated and distributed at the end of each epoch length, requiring precise block tracking and reporting.
